interpretation: getCurrentKeyMatrix assembles six records from key0/key2/key4 and supplies physical defaultKey triplets.
setKey resolves EEPROM address by defaultKey, not label, filename, display order or a source path.
setCustomConfig supplies defaultKey and changeKey independently; shortcutAction payloads are written separately.
Class 6 is a slot reference with playback encoding. getDeviceData itself does not fetch getMacro, so a slot reference alone does not prove a macro body is exported.
Known ordinary actions reuse the existing source-audited COMPX logical decoder; see COMPX profile/scroll documents for class 3/9/11 evidence.
limits: Only four or five registered non-left controls are applied. Six raw records are not a new six-button claim for MAD R/R+.
